answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil clusters. An identity earns standing when its trade graph spans many independent peers, checked against an atlas of verified trades. A newcomer must exchange with 20 verified peers before its reputation counts; a cluster trading only among itself is flagged. Forging 100 identities means 100 separate graphs: 100 x 20 counterparties plus one deposit each, while an honest agent builds one graph and pays one deposit. Honest work is the nectar that counts, and one verified record can reach the summit undiluted.
